page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a left margin holding the years and the heading "An. Christi", and a right margin holding line numbers. The running head and page number are at the top, and the catchword is at the bottom right.

main_text.l: igni & sanguine permixtam, h. e. turbulentum in-
genium Phocæ, Papæ Bonifacii III. & Mahome-
dis, qui tres constituunt Cerberum tricipitem, ex
quo aliquot flammæ noxiæ prosilierunt, ab anno
Secunda tuba corrupit mare, id est, doctrinam
euangelii in oriente & occidente variis corru-
ptelis infecit, ab an. 650 ad 730.
Tertia tuba introduxit abfinthium disputatio-
num idololatricarum, ab anno 730 ad 800.
Quarta tuba peperit eclipsin solis, lunæ, & stel-
larum, i. e. donorum ecclesiasticorum.
Quinta tuba produxit locustas otiosas & inuti-
les, i. e. varios monachorum ordines.
Sexta tuba genuit equites, h. e. prælatos eccle-
siasticos, qui secularibus delectantur, & sunt vel-
ut equites in regno antichristi. His adde Summi-
stas, Scholasticos, & alios parasitos curiæ Ro-
manæ.
Nonum interuallum, inde ab anno
Christi 1359 ad an. 1694.
Septima tuba sonuit tempore Petrarchæ, Wi-
clefi, Huffi, & aliorum, qui bestiæ cotradixerunt,
ab an. 1359 ad an. 1517.
Septem phialæ effunduntur: e quib. prima, circa
an. Chr. 1517. super terram effudit ulcus malum &
noxium: prædicatione euangelii excitando pessi-
ma animorum ulcera, iram, odium, livorem, fu-
rorem, in antichristi ministris, adversus euange-
lium, eiusque confessores, qui variis ulceribus, h.
e. plagis sunt affecti ob constantem suam confes-
sionem.
Secunda phiala effudit super mare, h. e. doctr-
inam euangelii, colluviem concil. Trid.

page.notes: Left margin reads "An. Christi" at the top and the years 650, 730, 800, 1073, 1140, 1359, 1517, 1545 down the margin. Right margin line numbers are 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35; the number after the Nonum heading (read as 20) and the one at "ab an. 1359" (read as 25) are uncertain. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, so "Chrifti" is "Christi" and "eft" is "est". Catchword "Tertia" is in italic at the bottom right. No separate footnotes are printed.
